hook: Your GPS says the Equator monument is misplaced.
title: The Equator Monument Is Not on the Equator
description:
Near Quito, Ecuador, the Mitad del Mundo monument is famous as the Equator. A handheld GPS puts the real zero-latitude line a few hundred metres away. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #Ecuador
comment_prompt: Would you visit the real Equator? Yes or no
